description: Restart during delivery of a directive update. The directive version must survive and be applied once; a newer directive can cancel or replace queued work; duplicates are harmless. The kill latch and cancellation also survive restart.
expected_observable: After restart the active directive_id+version is preserved; the update is applied exactly once (no duplicate application); a newer directive replaces queued work derived from the prior version; a duplicate directive_id is a no-op; a persisted cancel/kill-latch still blocks dispatch after recovery.

fixture_refs.directive: ledger directives row (directive_id PK, version, source, state, payload)
